programme.desc: Dusitn takes on classic Fall conditions explaining the best ways to approach bass throughout the day.

programme.title: FishON! | Spring on the Ivanhoe: Post-Spawn Walleye Adventures
programme.desc: In Episode 3, we navigate the serene waters of the Ivanhoe River, embracing the beauty of spring as we target post-spawn walleye. With rods in hand, we explore the river's productive fishing spots, uncovering the best techniques and tips for a successful catch in this transitional season. From scenic backdrops to thrilling strikes, this episode captures the essence of spring fishing at its finest.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | 2.5-Day Party Boat Fishing Trip on the El Dorado
programme.desc: In today’s episode of Stoked on Fishing, we're aboard the 85ft El Dorado, experiencing the unpredictability of summertime fishing off the West Coast

programme.title: Wired2Fish | Baits and Gear For the Biggest Catch
programme.desc: The team from Wired2Fish delivers the goods on how to catch the biggest fish—wherever or whenever you're casting lines.

programme.title: Angler's Workshop | Building A Ned Rig Rod
programme.desc: Jim shows you, in detail how to build your own Ned Rig rod.

programme.title: Jarrett Edwards Outdoors — Punching Plastics
programme.desc: Jarrett and Jared Lintner are punching plastics for bass on Clear Lake in California

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | The Ultimate Baja Mexico Fishing Trip: Stoked on La Paz – Part Three
programme.desc: Welcome to La Paz, the captivating capital of Baja California Sur, situated approximately 3/4 of the way down the breathtaking Baja Peninsula. La Paz is renowned for its stunning seafront beaches, lush parks, vibrant art scene, and waterfront dining that will leave you mesmerized. Join us as we embark on a thrilling adventure diving into this coastal paradise for the very first time.

programme.title: Hook n' Look — Point to Point
programme.desc: Secondary points, those adjacent to spawning pockets, are prime places for pre-spawn bass to congregate. A vibrating jig, delivered with a steady retrieve, then suddenly popped off the vegetation, proves to be just the ticket for Kim and these staging largemouths.

programme.title: Hank Parker Fishing
programme.desc: Fishing legend Hank Parker take viewers to the most secluded locations for the biggest fish.

programme.title: Catching Bass | Bluebird Summer
programme.desc: Dustin explains where to find bass under bluebird skies

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat Fishing on the Ranger 85 (Part 3)
programme.desc: Join the Stoked on Fishing crew as they travel to incredible fishing destinations, chase down a wide variety of species, and share the stories of the people and places behind each catch. Whether it’s offshore, inshore, freshwater, or somewhere off the beaten path, every episode brings you along for the adventure — with real anglers, real conditions, and no scripted nonsense.

programme.title: Larry Smith Outdoors
programme.desc: This week's show we're finally back on the ice and nothing better to make sure all your gear is set to go without bringing everything on about 3 inches of ice safety is everything!

programme.title: Angling Buzz - Easy Fishing Tactics
programme.desc: Fishing can be very high-tech, but on the other end of the spectrum, it can actually be very simple. Today we're going to show you some presentations and tactics to put fish in the boat....easily!

programme.title: Angling Buzz - All About Swimbaits
programme.desc: This episode is all about Swimbaits, perhaps the most versatile tool in the tackle box for catching just about everything that swims.

programme.title: Brent Chapmans Pro vs Joe-Finger Lakes Showdown
programme.desc: Brent Chapman delivers top tips on how to catch the biggest fish in the best spots.

programme.title: Brent Chapman’s Pro vs Joe -Lazy Lake Shootout
programme.desc: Brent Chapman delivers top tips on how to catch the biggest fish in the best spots.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - Cedros Island Adventure
programme.desc: The next few episodes are special because the crew heads down to the famous Cedros Island fishing for giant Yellowtail, Dorado, and Calico Bass. This trip is nothing new to us; Shea McIntee and the crew have been fishing at Cedros Island for more than a decade and always stay at Cedros Outdoor Adventurers because of their excellent staff, beautiful resort, and fantastic fishing boats and captains.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - Largemouth Bass Fishing at Lake El Salto, Part Two
programme.desc: If you're a bass fisherman, you have most likely heard of the world-class Lake El Salto. Dave Brown from Okuma Fishing Tackle and professional bass fisherman Todd Kline rally up with Savage Gear and test out their rat and duck lures on this Stoked On Fishing adventure.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: As fall grips Northern Ontario, unpredictable weather makes fishing a true test of patience and perseverance. Paul is joined by young angler Matthew, who’s finishing university and weighing the decision to stay in the North. Facing extreme cold on their first attempt, the duo regroup and return a few days later to a new lake, chasing walleye and capturing the stunning wilderness that makes Northern Ontario a fall angler’s paradise.

programme.title: FishON! | Remote Escapes: Pike Frenzy and Hidden Lake Explorations
programme.desc: In the thrilling Season 7 finale, Paul & Perry and the team venture deep into Northern Ontario, using a Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake with high hopes for walleye. However, the day takes a surprising turn as Northern Pike steal the show with their spirited action. The adventure doesn’t end there—a bonus portage into another lake offers a chance to explore uncharted waters. It’s a fitting conclusion to a season filled with the unexpected and unforgettable.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode we turkey hunt here in southwest Mississippi with Cragg Fitz from Trained Assassins TV. It's the opening week of turkey season in Mississippi and the birds are gobbling and looking for love. They whip us on opening morning but we stumble upon one that afternoon and make our move and he makes his! You won't want to miss this episode!

Brady Snyder proves why Iowa is legendary for trophy whitetails as he shares his double success from last season. Watch this bow hunting master break down the strategies that led to harvesting two big bucks in his home state. programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil warlock Nemesis shows up at the Wizards' Library to steal the knowledge from the Archives of Evil and so get the Long Life Stone. But it's Brainy who inadvertently saves the day when he switches Greedy's cookbook and Papa's spell book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Roommates Smurfette and Nanny are getting on each other's nerves, so the time has come for Nanny to have a house of her own. As Nanny and Smurfette trek off to find a house-warming plant, the others design the Smurfliest house for her.

programme.title: Smurfing For Ghosts
programme.desc: Peewit is at the castle of his friends Selwyn and Tallulah when Uncle Fenwick, the friendly ghost, asks for his help in chasing a few relatives who've come to haunt him... Peewit has to get help from the Smurfs, and a merry chase begins...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: We all know Grouchy Smurf hates a lot of things. But one thing he hates more than anything else is water, when there is enough of it to drown in. You see, Grouchy can't swim. And when the Smurfs notice this peculiarity and try to teach him how to survive in water, the evil wizard Gargamel makes things a little more dangerous than they ought to be....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: The Answer Smurf
programme.desc: Nobody ever listens to Brainy Smurf's advice, and when Papa Smurf is away and Brainy feels he's in charge, he decides he's going to be the one with all the answers. There is a magic formula in Papa Smurf's Book of Spells that ensures everyone in the Village of the Smurfs is going to ask for Brain's opinion. As if matters weren't difficult enough, here's Gargamel...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs are three apples high. Smurflings are twenty-five smurfberries high. Except for Slouchy, who only measures twenty-two smurfberries. Apart from Baby Smurf, Slouchy is the shortest Smurf, and the jibes and taunts of the other Smurflings make him wish he were the tallest of the Smurfs... Now it so happens that Gourdy the Genie loves to grant wishes...

programme.title: Smurfette's Gift
programme.desc: Every year, Smurfette snoops around to discover what her birthday presents will be before she receives them. But this year, Sassette has created the Keep-Smurfette's-Presents-a-Surprise-Committee. Nat has discovered a cave where they might be able to hide all the gifts prepared by the Smurfs. But what this cave also hides is a greedy imp who is not only interested in keeping Smurfette's gifts...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Oh dear! Sassette has lost a tooth. Papa Smurf explains that if she puts her tooth under her pillow, the Mouse Fairy will bring her a present in the morning. But the next morning there is no present under the pillow. The Mouse Fairy has not been. She has been captured in one of Gargamel’s Smurf traps. And now the evil wizard is concocting a dreadful plan.

programme.title: Smurfs On Wheels
programme.desc: Every year, all the Smurfs make the long hike to Dreamy Steamy Springs. But this year, only Grandpa Smurf, Papa Smurf and Nat are going to walk there. All the other Smurfs are too busy – and too lazy – to walk. But then Handy comes up with what he calls his Customised Smurfwagon. No need to walk, you just let yourself roll along... Of course, things won't be as simple as all that.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. But suddenly here he is smitten by the love of the medical profession. Dabbler wants to become a doctor and all of the Smurfs, with Papa Smurf in the lead, are going to help him to achieve his wish.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Poet Smurf's new play is going to be his greatest work ever, and it will feature the most favourite Smurf of all: Smurfette in the leading female role. All the other Smurfs vie for the honour of playing opposite Smurfette. Even Timid Smurf, who is the shy and retiring type, is a candidate for the part. Brainy Smurf, self-appointed manager of the play, does not see it that way...

programme.title: Reckless Smurfs
programme.desc: This time, Gargamel's plan cannot fail. Undeterred by Azrael's derisive cackling, the evil wizard perfects a magic substance called Daredevil Dust, which is going to change all the Smurfs into rash, incautious swashbucklers. Will Papa Smurf fall into Gargamel's trap? Will their enemy catch all the Smurfs? Will this story have a happy ending?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jokey's surprise exploding packages have been changed by a spell. Picture the practical joker's discombobulating when he realises that all the surprises that he hands to unsuspecting Smurfs contain nothing but real gifts! No more ka-boom, no more jokes, no more fun! Plus the unenviable new position of Most Popular Smurf in the Village, surrounded by admirers begging for more presents...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Helped, if that is the right word, by Scruple, his apprentice, the evil wizard Gargamel once again wants to catch the Smurfs. He is able to steal from Mother Nature a magic formula that wakes up the trees. Suddenly the forest speaks and moves! Now, for sure, Gargamel will be able to capture the little blue people, won't he? Or will he? And what if all the trees leave for good?

programme.title: A Myna Problem
programme.desc: Clumsy has found a new friend. A Myna bird, very good speaker indeed, apt to repeat every syllable it hears... even not very nice things, thus creating a lot of bad feelings in the Village of the Smurfs. How this bird can change the Smurfs into ducks and how this strange circumstance foils one more of Gargamel's evil plans will have to be seen to be believed.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life isn't always easy for Scruple, the evil wizard Gargamel's young apprentice. Gargamel is a crabby, peevish, cantankerous company at best. But, here is a magic formula that is guaranteed to change the meanest of persons into a gentle, loving soul. Scruple lures his master into drinking it... and paradoxically, this means that the Smurf Village is in greater danger than ever!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: At last here is a post worthy of the great Gargamel's talent and experience! At least, that's what the evil wizard thinks as he learns of Prince Theodore's need of a new court magician. The Smurfs are delighted when they see Gargamel and his good-for-nothing apprentice, Scruple, leaving their hovel in the forest. But maybe they are rejoicing too soon. Who knows what peril Gargamel has in store?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Get up early in the morning, before any other Smurf is out of bed, to prepare a scrumptious Smurfberry muffin. Spend all morning on preparing Smurf delicacies for lunch. Than all afternoon to have dinner ready – and delicious – on time. And do you get so much as a thank you form the Smurfs? So Greedy Smurf quits. The Village is in trouble... And soon, so is Greedy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Yes, there can be too much of a good thing. When an accident happens to Papa Smurf's magic formula and he ends up multiplied by two, the Smurfs are elated: two Papa Smurfs can give twice the good counsel and twice the loving that one can. But after a while, things get too complex in the Village. Especially when another accident doubles the number of Gargamels!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Greenpeedeepee Swamp is the only place you can find Swamp Root, the delicious and necessary ingredient of Greedy Smurf’s famed swamp root stew. Unfortunately, it is also one place where you can find those hideous Wartmongers. Even though Sassette and the Smurfs save a young Wartmonger’s life, they still end up being captured by the others. But the Scarlet Croaker will save them! Maybe.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: Gargamel's Mis-Fortune
programme.desc: Gargamel, the evil but incompetent wizard, tries to trick Esmeralda, the gypsy, into giving him a formula to catch the Smurfs. Of course the gypsy proves to be much smarter than Gargamel, and the Smurfs even more so.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The village of the Smurfs used to live without a clock. But now suddenly time becomes a precious commodity and Brainy Smurf designs a schedule to take advantage of the new Village clock... Can the Smurfs survive the attacks of time?

programme.title: Hefty And The Wheelsmurfer
programme.desc: Hefty Smurf learns what is to be handicapped when he breaks his leg. Handy Smurf creates the wheelsmurfer for him, a contraption that will give Hefty some mobility. But suddenly the evil wizard Gargamel appears on the scene.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha, the repulsive witch, captures the Smurfette. She wants to steal from the little blue beauty her golden hair. Can the Smurfs save their little female companion before it is too late? Can Hogatha grow hair like Smurfette's?

programme.title: Monster Smurfs
programme.desc: This is spook-a-Smurf eve, and all the Smurfs get ready for the fancy dress party… But Brainy Smurf gets hold of Papa Smurf's Book of Magic, and all the Smurfs are changed into hideous but funny creatures. Yet danger lurks...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hefty Smurf meets an old Trolless in the forest, and the old crone begs him to relieve her of a red spot on her nose by... giving her a good kick here and now! Hefty half-heartedly obliges... And the result is a big surprise for him!

programme.title: The Trojan Smurf
programme.desc: Gargamel, the evil wizard, has devised a new plan to capture the Smurfs: he builds a giant statue in the shape of Papa Smurf. Thus, he hopes, the Smurfs are going to drag the statue into their Village.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There isn't a River Smurf anymore: someone has frozen it near its source. The Smurfs go to the Emerald Empress' country to see what the trouble is, and they meet the Patchwork Bear as well as the Iron Pyrites...

programme.title: Smurfette's Sweet Tooth
programme.desc: Once a year, Greedy Smurf makes a special batch of Smurfberry candy. Every Smurf receives a whole year's provision of the smurfiest candy in the whole world. But can a Smurf keep his provision for a whole year? Can the Smurfette?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This time, Gargamel feels sure of himself. Well, almost. He is going to try and finally catch the little Smurfs! Greedy Smurf's lighter-than-air pancakes are almost responsible for the Smurfs floating into Gargamel's grasp...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf's done it again. This time, in front of Papa Smurf, too. He has recited a spell that changes everything to stone. Everything including himself and all the Smurfs and the Village, and the forest around for miles... Fortunately, Peewit appears....

programme.title: The Bignose Dilemma
programme.desc: Vanity dislikes having the same blue nose as any other Smurf. What he needs is something special... Bignose, Bigmouth's fiancée, also wants to change her nose. And so, by the way, does Gargamel. Some nose exchanging takes place...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The boy from the wood and Laconia, the deaf-mute elf, ask Papa Smurf to celebrate their wedding. The Smurfs are getting the party ready, following the advice of the Smurfette, when Gargamel comes to put a spoke in their wheel.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Guess who's coming back to the Village of the Smurfs? Grandpa Smurf himself, who's been away for some five hundred years. He returns with grave news: the Smurfs will have to find the four magical elements to make the long life Stone, or their very existence is going to be in jeopardy. Can they do it in just one day?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking a treasure is to be found, Gargamel follows the Smurfs every step: into Jack Frost's cave, then to the desert in search of the Pyramid of Zenobia, and in the West Wind's lair... The Smurfs must find the four elements of the long life Stone before sundown. But can it be done? Can the Smurfs preserve their very existence?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: While the Smurfs left at the Village try to find Grandpa Smurf's box and survive a flood caused by a geyser, Grandpa himself, Papa Smurf, Sassette and a few Smurfs more try to secure the last missing element from a volcano guarded by the terrifying wooden Tikis... and Gargamel, with Azrael as usual, do their best to foul things up for the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As if Gargamel didn't have enough troubles as it is. Now he is saddled with a new problem, a problem by the name of Scruple, a new apprentice. A lazy, insolent, good-for-nothing character who will help in getting hold of the enchanted quill, a magic pen that writes nothing but the truth... and is going, or so Gargamel hopes, to aid in catching the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Snappy doesn't always do as he is told. For instance, he is a little careless in putting out the campfire where the Smurfs have been roasting marshmallows. Even though the Smurfs are doing the impossible in trying to save the forest from the holocaust, the situation looks bleak. Snappy is hunted by remorse. And he would be even more so if he knew what the evil Gargamel is up to.

programme.title: Can't Smurf The Music
programme.desc: There is nothing the sorceress Chlorhydris hates so much as love in the world. She would like to see all love banished from the face of the Earth, and she's going to start with music. She puts a spell on a magic horn so that it will suck the music out of every song... especially the Smurfs' songs. Helped by their friend Laconia, the Smurfs may be able to resist Chlorhydris' evil plan...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel has got hold of magical ectoplasmic crystal eggs that will enable him to change bodies with Papa Smurf. What better plan could there be? Disguised as Papa Smurf, he's going to lead all the Smurfs to his cauldron! But as fate would have it, Gargamel is changed into Puppy, the Smurf doggie...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's not every day you meet a talking flower. Especially not a character like Petaluma, a somewhat haughty bulb flower who Smurfette meets in the forest. Of course the delighted Smurfette takes Petaluma to the Village of the Smurfs... and starts a process that is going to endanger all of the Smurfs. Flowers, it seems, ought to be seen and not heard.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Everybody can make a mistake. Take Papa Smurf, for instance. His new perfume-enhancing spray makes a rose smell like a thousand roses...but due to a whole series of misadventures it also makes all the Smurfs cry, moved to tears by the slightest of pretexts. While they sob, bawl, wail moan and whimper, the evil wizard Gargamel does not stand still...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Tonight is talent show night in the Village of the Smurfs. Grandpa Smurf is going to do magic tricks, Sassette is going to perform with her trained pet frog, Clumsy is going to try his hand at juggling... and Jokey Smurf has made a dummy of Gargamel that he is sure will frighten the Smurfs out of their wits. But the real Gargamel finds a way to animate Jokey's dummy and then...

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Baby Smurf has lost all interest in toys. Even Jokey's surprises fail to amuse the tiny tyke. Grandpa Smurf suggests they go and pay a visit to the Toymaker, the one who makes toys for children all over the world. Or rather used to make: the Toymaker is tired of the lack of appreciation his toys receive from those who receive them.

programme.title: Handy's Window-Vision
programme.desc: Miner Smurf leaves no stone unturned and this is how he discovers a crystal that transmits images. Thus Handy is able to invent window-vision and, every morning from then on, the Smurfs are able to watch Hefty's workouts, Farmer Smurf's crop reports or even the Brainy Smurf Hour. But would you believe it? The evil wizard Gargamel takes advantage of this image-watching to catch Smurfs!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf has been elected Wizard of the Year, and the evil wizard Gargamel is beside himself with jealousy. He will see to it that Papa's powers all disappear. And then, he is sure to catch all the Smurfs and celebrate with a big feast... But now, would Papa Smurf let such a bad thing happen? Surely not, Papa finds a way to foil Gargamel's plan...

programme.title: The Colour Smurf
programme.desc: Spectra is the Colour Fairy, the one whose wheel of colours make all the blues, reds, yellows and greens of the world. She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sweepy the chimney sweep Smurf is not the most popular inhabitant of the Village of the Smurfs. He is rather messy, and the clouds of soot that he makes certainly don't add to his popularity. Only the Smurflings find him great company as he's the only one who can get dirty and not be told off. Yet in their enthusiasm for Sweepy, the Smurflings endanger the Village.

programme.title: Don Smurfo
programme.desc: Everyone has their own dreams. That of Smurfette is to meet the legendary Don Smurfo, the dashing, witty, swashbuckling hero of many an engrossing tale. The Smurfs shrug at this infatuation. But when a real-life Don Smurfo appears in the village and Smurfette snubs them all in favor of the bragging stranger, they take the matter a little more seriously.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What is in the box that's been found by Jokey Smurf? A cloak belonging to Wizlow the Magician gnome. And what sort of cloak? Jokey learns that it's a cloak of invisibility. Whoever wears it has a great opportunity of playing practical jokes... And guess what havoc an invisible Jokey is able to wreak on the Village. Yet if Wizlow parted with the cloak, there must be a reason...

programme.title: Snappy's Way
programme.desc: Did you know that if you catch a troll, he may grant you one wish? It just happens that Aloysius the Troll gets caught in one of Gargamel's Smurf traps. Snappy Smurf sets him free and as a reward, gets to make all other Smurfs obey his every whim. Now this brings a lot of trouble to the Smurfs, as Smurflings, sometimes, ask for things that are not good for them... or anybody else.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf is aghast. Sassette cannot read, and thus might be forever prevented from learning the pearls of wisdom collected in his book "Brainy Smurf's quotations"! He tries teaching her how to read. What she can read almost from the start is a formula to make all the books disappear! All the books in the world, including Gargamel's spells and Homnibus' books of remedies!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In another Smurf theatrical super-production based – very loosely – on Alexandre Dumas' characters, a masterpiece of the stage is created, with a few lines from Romeo and Juliet thrown in.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs come to the rescue of two children and their grandfather when a mysterious stranger appears and causes their sleigh to crash. Knocking on Gargamel's door for help puts them and the Smurfs in danger…

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy has built a very complex Smurf machine that does everything. It proves dangerous when it nearly destroys the village, but comes in useful when, with the help of the other Smurfs, it saves the young prince Gerard's kingdom from the queen aunt Imperia's dastardly intentions.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover a fountain of youth that is guarded by a wicked troll, who steals Papa Smurf's magic book. They convince Gargamel to help them and the greedy villain runs to get the water, but manages to fall in with the troll. As the two chase each other all over the countryside, the Smurfs are able to retrieve Papa Smurf's book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Once in a blue moon, as the legend goes, a baby Smurf is delivered to the Smurfs and everyone in the village becomes attached to the new arrival. But a mistake has been made and the stork returns to take the baby back. Grouchy and Smurfette have become so attached to the baby that the baby is returned.

programme.title: Lightening Point

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2

At the same time, Lewis finds himself in desperate need of a job after his laptop dies and, unbeknownst to him, he is offered Cleo’s old job. Upset, the girls use their mermaid powers to make the job unbearable for Lewis.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Riding their dirt bikes, Zane and Nate stop in a trailer park to look at a classic Harley. Nate steals a badge from the bike and Zane is busted by the owner - little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Later, embarrassed by her family’s financial situation, Rikki hides where she really lives from Zane. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Elliot is going to horse riding lessons and Emma is cornered into taking him. Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. They clash immediately. Emma tries to prove herself and goes too far. When a horse falls ill Emma must use her powers to fix the situation. Meanwhile, Lewis asks Cleo to accompany him to a formal awards night in a limo.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Cleo is failing at school. Lewis waits for Cleo to ask him for help, giving Charlotte an idea - she volunteers to help tutor Cleo! Cleo is horrified but is forced by Don to accept. Charlotte takes the opportunity to set Cleo mountains of homework; keeping Cleo busy so she can have Lewis all to herself. Charlotte pressures Lewis to take her to Mako Island so she can sketch some landscapes.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Zane hears of treasure under the ocean and enlists Rikki to help find it, after all a mermaid can search the bottom of the ocean pretty fast. Rikki gets Emma and Cleo to help, but conceals her true reasons for wanting the treasure.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Emma starts acting very weird after pricking her finger on a mysterious barb of coral, suddenly becoming ravenous for things like anchovy flavoured fish food! programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha and the Hare are having an epic game of hockey. When the game is at its peak, Masha goes off to find the missing puck and stumbles upon a broom. Now this is much better than a hockey stick and Masha gets an idea. But it turns out the broom can be used for things other than hockey.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear has a plan to save the sweltering She-Bear> He's planned a date and made refreshing homemade lemonade from his own grown lemons. But as usual, Masha bursts into the plan. Treat the whole forest with lemonade - that's the best idea! Quiet date - that's not great! Hello lemonade fever!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?! - Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn’t like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Once there was a girl called Anya who was very scared of insects! One day Anya’s mother asked her to help around the house but in everything she did, Anya was haunted by spiders and all kinds of midges! She was on the edge of despair when her little brother proved to her, that little crumbs can’t be of any danger to giants like children!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Alert! Bear’s fridge is in danger! Someone has burst into his house to stay for life…but the Bear is ready for everything to defend his stocks! He calls for a savior, but in reality it turns to be a new intriguing story full of unexpected discoveries which leads Masha to some peculiar conclusions!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The technologies some time can teach us a human lesson like in this story about two robots. One of them was presented to Masha for her birthday and the other one was made by the Bear to help him around, but tried to become the boss. Everything turned into great mess and only an unexpectedly awakened feeling between two robots put everything in its place.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Panda- the Bear’s distant relative pays one more visit to the Bear. They start making Chinese dump-lings, but then Masha appears, with her own methods of cooking. And a simple cooking turns into a culinary master class with butterflies!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one’s pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy starts to worry her whims might have consequences and brings in a scientist and a theologist to unpack chaos theory, the butterfly effect, and free will—while she processes the futility of it all. A game-show parody (“Lucky Case Game”) goes off the rails, the house band Rodent’s Revenge keeps the chaos moving, and Poppy “liberates” her beloved plants with the gift of free will. TV-14. Fictional violence and language.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy calls off “spin the bottle” when the puppets’ gross habits come to light, launching a chaotic crash course in hygiene and self-care. A parody round of Is It Cake? serves up a shocking twist, Detective Poppy makes a noir-style debut to hunt down a nasty rumor about Mr. Skip, and Zwink gets a spa day that tackles stink and sadness—ending with a catchy cleanliness anthem. TV-14. Fictional violence and language.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum artist Darius Rucker joins Joel Madden to reflect on his journey from fronting Hootie & the Blowfish to becoming a country music icon. Rucker opens up about balancing family and touring, the band’s legacy, and the honesty that drives his songwriting. He also discusses breaking barriers in country music and his new memoir, Life’s Too Short, offering heartfelt insight into perseverance and authenticity.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Nebraska-born singer, songwriter, and director Tim Kasher, frontman of Cursive, joins Joel Madden to discuss nearly 30 years of indie rock evolution, the band’s new album Devourer, and finding meaning in creative longevity. programme.title: Anthony Green: So Long, Avalon Live In New York
programme.desc: Experience Anthony Green live from the Gramercy Theatre in New York as he celebrates the release of So Long, Avalon. An intimate, high–energy set blends new material with fan favorites, spontaneous crowd moments, and a playful nod to classic “Kokomo.” Green spotlights his touring band — Greg Mervine (drums), Sean Cohen (multi-instrumentalist), Dave Davison, and Keith Goodwin — and shouts out friends Kurt Travis and Geoff Rickly for helping shape a special night. A dynamic performance that captures Green’s voice, humor, and gratitude in a room full of true believers.

programme.title: Kansas: Miracles out of Nowhere
programme.desc: A 2015 full-length documentary film tells the untold story of a successful American rock band. In-depth interviews with all 6 original members recount their rise.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with 6LACK. Born in Baltimore and raised in Atlanta, 6LACK grew up around music from the start - his father owned a recording studio, and he was already stepping into the booth by age four. After cutting his teeth as a teenage battle rapper, he broke through in 2016 with his debut album Free 6lack, which spawned the Grammy-nominated single "PRBLMS" and established the introspective, emotionally direct sound he's known for. His follow-up, East Atlanta Love Letter, debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200, and his most recent album, Since I Have a Lover, earned him a Grammy nomination for Best Progressive R&B Album. Along the way, he's collaborated with everyone from J. Cole and Lil Baby to Elton John and Gorillaz. A decade into his career, 6LACK joins Joel in the Artist Friendly studio to open up about how he has spent the last few years simplifying his life — cutting out excess, opportunists, and old habits — confronting the ego he didn't know he had, and learning what it actually means to build a life around what matters most.

programme.title: Chase Atlantic: LOST IN HEAVEN

programme.title: MisterWives: The Don’t Look Down Tour: Live from The Wiltern
programme.desc: Indie-pop band MisterWives close out The Don’t Look Down Tour with an electrifying, sold-out performance at The Wiltern in Los Angeles. Fronted by Mandy Lee, the group performs a dynamic mix of hits and new songs from their album Nosebleeds, blending soaring vocals, raw emotion, and vibrant stage energy. The night captures the band’s message of resilience, growth, and celebration as they connect with fans in a transformative live experience.

programme.title: Este Vampiro es un Tiro
programme.desc: Un vampiro vive en una hacienda abandonada y se aburre así que se va en busca de aventuras al pueblo.

programme.title: Los Cargadores

programme.title: El Coyote Mente Diabolica
programme.desc: Bulmaro Reyes comandante retirado de la policía, debido a su violento carácter que quiso asesinar al hombre que mato a su familia, se ve obligado a ir en busca de aquel hombre que se ha fugado y que por sanguinario le llaman el coyote. apoyado por su excompañero en la policía, el comandante Ríos inicia una insólita persecución a caballo en busca del asesino.

programme.title: La Ley de mi Texana

programme.title: El Charro de Tacubaya

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia expulsa a Ricardo tras sus ataques contra Manuela, quien revela que Katiuska es amante de este. Alejandro es echado de la iglesia por el padre al ser visto con Margot, revelándose luego que no es sacerdote. Mientras Hortensia se prepara para su boda con Benjamín, este es interceptado por Misael y Julio César. Finalmente, se confirma que Celia espera un varón, noticia que genera gran revuelo, mientras Elizabeth guarda luto por la Nona.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel León es un famoso presentador televisivo famoso por su vitalidad y buena presencia pero en uno de sus programas sufre un desmayo y entonces va al médico y este le dice que deberá hacer un tratamiento de diálisis o hacerse un trasplante. Gabriel le confiesa esta verdad a su manager y amigo Epicúreo y también le dice que el donante será uno de sus hijos que no conoce pero que sabe que existen porque cuando tenía 18 años fue donante de esperma y le encarga a Epicúreo que se ocupe de encontrar a esos hijos. Epicúreo se hace pasar por diferentes roles y consigue la información que Gabriel estaba buscando o al menos algo de ella.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel conoce a Magdalena. Ella es la encargada de sacarle las fotos para la campaña publicitaria. Es muy dulce y queda enganchado con ella. Epicúreo va a entrevistar a Valentina Pacheco, pero con una información errónea. Y ella empieza a pensar en la hija que tuvo y dio, mediante fecundación in Vitro. Julieta siente que está defraudando a sus padres, por trabajar en un periódico de chimentos. Angie (esposa de Gabriel) está muy enojada porque él apaga su teléfono y no consigue localizarlo. Magdalena invita a Sofía (su ginecóloga) a cenar a su casa para ver si existe la posibilidad de tener otro hijo. Agustín se enoja con Sofía (que es su amante). Ya que le había pedido que dijera que eso era imposible, sin embargo Sofía afirma lo contrario.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Brenda le cuenta a Gabriel la historia del niño. Pero él no quiere hacerse cargo. Magdalena muy enojada le regresa las flores a Gabriel a su oficina. Lilibel y Nayarí intentan buscar los papeles del donante de Deibis, pero no lo consiguen. Marilyn le cuenta todo lo que pasa a Angie. Está se enoja mucho y más cuando Magdalena devuelve las flores. Ana Belén le cuenta a Efraín sobre la visita de Valentina. Gabriel se queda muy mal cuando conoce la sala de hemodiálisis y niega su enfermedad. Angie especula de las relaciones de Gabriel, con todas las mujeres que se han presentado últimamente. Brenda la pasa muy mal. No sólo Gabriel se desentiende del asunto, sino que la echan del trabajo y de su departamento

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía le revela a Magdalena el secreto que le tenía guardado: Agustín, su marido, es infértil, y por lo tanto, no es el padre de su hijo Rodrigo. Impactada por semejante noticia, Magdalena se pierde por las calles de la ciudad, totalmente desconsolada. Pero lo que no le revelaron, es que Agustín y Sofía, son amantes desde hace años. Angie, celosa de unas flores que recibió Gabriel, finalmente consigue que su novio acepte ir con ella al cocktail de la revista Ricos y Famosos esa misma noche. Pero al final, Gabriel la deja plantada porque va en busca de Magdalena luego de que la llamara y notara su tristeza. Angie entra en cólera por la desaparición de Gabriel y decide ir de todas formas al cocktail y emborracharse.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena le insiste a Sofía en saber quién es el padre de su hijo, pero Sofía le miente diciendo que no tiene forma de saberlo. Además, quiere aprovechar el distanciamiento que ahora hay entre Magdalena y Agustín para quedarse con él. Pero Agustín no quiere saber nada con Sofía, sino que sigue enamorado de Magdalena. En El Maratón de la Alegría, Gabriel busca deshacerse de la inesperada interrupción al aire de Brenda. Una vez estando juntos y a solas, Gabriel le remarca que él fue simplemente un donante y que no se hará cargo del chico, aunque se apiada de ella y la toma como nueva empleada de su empresa. Ana Belén y Efraín están mal en su relación. Ambos sienten que ya no hay pasión.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: El socio de Heriberto lo visita en la cárcel para confesarle que ahora se alió con Reina para secuestrar a Alejandro, ya que ella le pagará más.Reina lleva sedado a Alejandro a un hotel y lo hace pasar por parapléjico, pero cuando sale olvida su teléfono, y Alejandro aprovecha para llamar a Sol y contarle que lo tienen ahí, y también pedirle que llame a la policía. Luego Reina regresa antes que Alejandro escape, y se lo lleva junto a su nuevo socio en una camioneta.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto logra escapar de la cárcel y le pasa información a Maricielo sobre el posible escondite al que Reina irá con Alejandro. La policía consigue dar con los secuestradores y recuperar sano y salvo a Alejandro, pero Reina se da a la fuga. A último momento, es interceptada por las patrullas. Luego, Heriberto se dirige a la casa de Sol y le dice que ha ayudado a la policía para recuperar a Alejandro. Ella confía en él pero, al momento de brindar, Heriberto le pone una droga en su bebida.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Reina es apresada y luego la atropella un automóvil. Heriberto le escribe una carta a Sol y le hace creer que hicieron el amor. Víctor Hugo es apresado por Maricielo. Tras su arresto, Carlos le reprocha a Alicia el haber sido la responsable de la muerte de Ramón. José Domingo se entera de que puede ser el padre de Alicia y Alejandro. Eloy y Columba se reconcilian. Cristo José le dice a Bárbara que se va a divorciar pero también le comenta a Giselle que tampoco quiere estar con ella.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro logra confesarle a Sol que no son hermanos. Insegura por la situación vivida con Heriberto, Sol se hace estudios para tratar de determinar si tuvieron relaciones. Luego visita a Heriberto en la cárcel, donde él le confiesa que la drogó, pero que no le dio el coraje para abusar de ella. Alicia hace un acuerdo con Cristina para que ella figure como la donante en su trasplante de médula, pero al momento de la operación, Cristina no está. Alicia hace esfuerzos para que no logren sedarla.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Alejandro anuncian que se van a casar y también que Sol está embarazada. Reina le dice a Sol que Heriberto la violó y que el hijo que espera es de él. Sol recibe una prueba médica que verifica que lo que le dijo Reina es verdad. Heriberto es trasladado, para luego ser llevado a Texas, donde será ejecutado. Durante el trayecto, llama a Sol. Heriberto le repite que no la violó pero la llamada se corta. Alejandro le pregunta a Sol qué pasa y esta le dice que ya no podrán ser felices.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri siguen besándose. Cada uno de ellos pensando en lo feliz que se sienten. El se despide de ella y quedan en no hablarse más. Carolina le forma un escándalo a Segundo por besarla pero piensa que le gusta más que los besos de Juan Diego. Se van del local. Atanasio sigue aconsejando a Juan Diego en lo que se refiere a las mujeres. Wilker anima a su mamá a que se consiga un novio para que la acompañe. Ella le dice que no | que lo que quieres es que se case y tenga bastantes nietos.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la agencia siguen con la repartición de regalos. Olegario y Junior están acompañando a Fabián que está sumamente triste por no estar pasándola con su Finita e hijas. En la agencia siguen con los regalos. Ana ya le regaló a Pastor y Pastor a Mauricio. Lolita y Dionisia quieren atender a ROKUro como un rey. El tiene pena. Carolina sigue pensando en el beso de Segundo y viendo la hora que es y Juan Diego no la llama. Juan Diego le regala a Yubiri y se abrazan.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Por fin se despiden en la agencia y todos se dan el feliz año Mauricio le dice a Pastor que el año que viene tendrá que ayudar a Ana en los arreglos del matrimonio. Briggite lleva a Wilker a un restaurante . Este cuando entra casi se muere pues no sabe de donde va a pagar Briggite viendo el nerviosismo de Wilker | le dice que ella va a pagar. El le dice que no | que un hombre no debe permitir eso. Juan Diego está almorzando en la casa de Yubiri. Todos los atienden como si fuer a un rey.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En casa de ROKUro todos están llorando por la emotividad de las palabras de ROKUro y Bienvenida. En la casa de Jesica y Junior están Pastor | Fabián y Olegario. También está el Doctor Caridad todos cenando. Se presenta Carolina a pedirle un favor a Junior. Yubiri y Mayerlin se quedaron en la casa | cuidándola mientras que los demás fueron a acompañar a ROKUro. Wilker le trae un dulce a Bienvenida. Entra a la casa y comienza a hablar con Yubiri y s e presenta Mayerlin..

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Ana casi se desmaya con la noticia de la tarjetas. Entra Pastor y las ve y también casi se desmaya. El único feliz con todo esto es Mauricio. Junior va a la bruja que le dijo Graciela. La bruja le dice que no busque más porque la mujer que está buscando está cerca | muy cerca de el. Wilker está preocupado por lo del CD ya que no confía en el productor. Yubiri lo ve y se sienta con él . El le cuenta su preocupación y ella lo anima. El la besa y le dice que su CD se lo va a dedicar a ella.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene y Leonardo vuelven del viaje y Felipe los espera ansioso. Alejandra se entera de que se filtró un correo donde piden a alguien para su puesto y confronta a Leonardo, quien la saca violentamente de su oficina. Rodrigo amenaza a Rebeca con revelar todo el plan si Adolfo y ella deciden traicionarlos. Además, le pregunta qué pasaría si se supiera que ella es la asesina de Miguel Ferrándiz. Anzola le declara su amor a Trinidad y esta lo rechaza. Jimena tiene una dura conversación con Carlos Ernesto en la cual él le pide que lo deje amar a Virginia. Luego, Jimena se enfrenta a Virginia y le confiesa que tiene dudas sobre la autoría del crimen. Virginia le dice que ama a Carlos Ernesto y que luchará con todo para limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto y Leonardo hablan acerca de las sospechas del segundo sobre la verdadera paternidad de Mateo, el hijo de Irene. Sin que ellos lo sepan, Rebeca los está escuchando. Virginia y Jimena se reconcilian y le comunican la buena nueva a Carlos Ernesto, quien se muestra feliz y agradecido. Leo es liberado de la cárcel y se reencuentra con su padre. En una molesta discusión, pregunta si cuando se vuelvan a casar, van a firmar la separación de bienes. Sandra invita a salir a Fernando para poder mostrarle que María Lucía está de novia y muy feliz con Damián. Trinidad le cuenta a Zulay la propuesta de Anzola y Zulay la insta a aceptarla. Al mismo tiempo, Anzola se lamenta con Coromoto por la negativa de Trinidad.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe duda del amor genuino de Irene y le pide que se casen. Irene le plantea varias preguntas cuyas respuestas decidirán si se casa con él o no. Pero luego Felipe recibe la inesperada visita de Leonardo, quien le reclama acerca de la verdadera paternidad de Mateo. Tras una acalorada discusión, Leonardo se retira. Virginia le cuenta a Irene acerca de la propuesta matrimonial de Anzola, cuando alguien toca el timbre. Es Rodrigo que viene por María Lucía, pretende invitarla a Europa y darle una vida de lujos. Rebeca cambia la medicación de Agustina y esta última sufre un colapso nervioso del que son testigos Coromoto, Jimena y Adolfo. Adolfo amenaza nuevamente a Rodrigo y lo insta a que frene la reapertura del caso de Miguel Ferrándiz.
